title: INSTALL STARTING HOUSING / PERFORMANCE TEST OF REDUCTION TYPE STARTER

content.description: Installation of starter housing on magnetic switch assembly

items: (a) Place the starter housing on the magnetic switch and install two screws.
(c) Connect the coil lead to the terminal on the magnetic switch.

content.text: PERFORMANCE TEST OF REDUCTION TYPE STARTER
These tests must be performed within 3 to 5 seconds to avoid burning out the coil.

items: (a) Disconnect the field coil lead from terminal C.
(b) Connect the battery to the magnetic switch as shown. Check that the plunger moves outward.

content.text: If the plunger does not move, replace the magnetic switch.

content.description: Pull-in test setup showing battery connected to magnetic switch with Terminal 50 and Terminal C labeled

items: (a) While connected as above with the plunger out, disconnect the negative lead from terminal C. Check that the plunger remains out.

content.text: If the plunger returns inward, replace the magnetic switch.

content.description: Hold-in test setup showing battery connected to magnetic switch

content.text: Disconnect the negative lead from the switch body. Check that the plunger returns inward.
If the plunger does not return, replace the magnetic switch.

content.description: Plunger return test setup showing battery connected to magnetic switch

items: (a) Connect the battery and ammeter to the starter as shown.
(b) Check that the starter rotates smoothly and steadily with the pinion moving out. Check that the ammeter reads the specified current.

content.description: No-load performance test setup showing battery and ammeter connected to starter with Terminal 30 labeled
